# Brieflaw — Tasks & Design Notes

## Overview

- **Source Template**: ColorLib Schmidt (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/schmidt/`)
- **New Name**: `brieflaw`
- **Category**: Professional Services / Portfolio

## Implementation Order & Structure

1. **Navbar (`Navbar.tsx`)**: Responsive header with brand logo and anchor navigation items (Home, About, Services, Experiences, Works, Blog, Contact).
2. **Hero (`Hero.tsx`)**: Split hero layout with professional subheading, title, CTA buttons ("More About Me", "Hire Me"), and carousel image showcase.
3. **Services (`Services.tsx`)**: Key offerings and practice areas grid.
4. **Experiences (`Experiences.tsx`)**: Timeline of professional background and roles.
5. **Works (`Works.tsx`)**: Portfolio grid showcasing recent projects/cases.
6. **Blog (`Blog.tsx`)**: Insights and articles list.
7. **Contact (`Contact.tsx`)**: Inquiry form and contact details.
8. **Footer (`Footer.tsx`)**: Copyright notice and mandatory Component Dock link (`https://www.componentdock.com/`).

## Fidelity Notes

- **Color Palette**: Gold accent (`#d5c455`), dark charcoal (`#222222`), clean white backgrounds (`#ffffff`).
- **Typography**: Poppins sans-serif font loaded via Google Fonts in `index.html`.
- **Images**: Use deterministic picsum seed `https://picsum.photos/seed/brieflaw-1/800/1000`.
